title: The Predictive Role of Subcutaneous Adipose Tissue in the Pathogenesis of Obstructive Sleep Apnoea.
summary: Deep-learning and random-forest models predict OSA severity from anthropometric, blood-test and ultrasound SAT measures in 100 patients; a stated 75:25 teaching/testing split and repeated analyses yielded >90% effectiveness after an apparent 97% in-sample classification. Single-center, small cohort; the paper notes SAT/AHI correlations were not significant, so the model is exploratory and does not establish causal pathogenesis or external clinical performance.
ai_technology: Methods §2.7 describes deep neural-network and random-forest classification using Deepnet/caret and variable-importance methods; Results apply them to airway-obstruction and OSA-category prediction.
